description.en: Design a fast typeahead for search suggestions

problemStatement.ar: صمم نظام autocomplete يرجع اقتراحات في أقل من 100ms. الـ corpus كبير، والـ QPS عالي لأن كل حرف طلب. ناقش هيكل الفهرس، الـ caching، والتحديثات.
problemStatement.en: Design an autocomplete system that returns suggestions in under 100ms. The corpus is large and QPS is high because every keystroke is a request. Discuss index structure, caching, and updates.

prompt.ar: قبل التصميم: اسأل عن الـ scope واعمل حسبة.
prompt.en: Before designing: clarify scope and estimate.

text.en: Asked about corpus: users/products/queries and size

ar.how: اسأل: prefix only ولا fuzzy؟ لغة عربية؟
ar.mistakes: خطأ: Elasticsearch افتراضي من غير access pattern.

en.how: Ask: prefix only or fuzzy? Arabic?
en.mistakes: Mistake: defaulting to Elasticsearch without access pattern.

text.ar: قدّرت 100k suggest QPS وavg 3 chars قبل النتائج
text.en: Estimated 100k suggest QPS and avg 3 chars before results

ar.how: كل keystroke = request. Debounce على العميل.
ar.tradeoffs: Debounce يقلل QPS ويحسّس بـ lag.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تنسى إن QPS ≈ keystrokes مش searches.

en.how: Each keystroke = request. Client debounce.
en.tradeoffs: Debounce lowers QPS and can feel laggy.
en.mistakes: Mistake: forgetting QPS ≈ keystrokes not searches.

text.ar: وضّحت freshness للتحديثات (منتج جديد امتى يظهر)
text.en: Clarified freshness for updates (when a new product appears)

ar.how: Seconds للـ social usernames؛ minutes للكتالوج.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعد فوري على فهرس ضخم موزّع.

en.why: How much index lag is OK?
en.how: Seconds for social usernames; minutes for catalog.
en.mistakes: Mistake: promising instant on a huge distributed index.

text.ar: سألت عن personalization والـ NSFW filters
text.en: Asked about personalization and NSFW filters

ar.how: Global popularity + user context + safety.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: ترجع نتائج من غير safety filter.

en.why: Ranking is not just prefix match.
en.how: Global popularity + user context + safety.
en.mistakes: Mistake: returning results without a safety filter.

prompt.ar: اوصف edge/CDN، API، trie/prefix index، وranking.
prompt.en: Describe edge/CDN, API, trie/prefix index, and ranking.

text.ar: 📊 Client → CDN/LB → API → Cache → Prefix Index → DB
text.en: 📊 Client → CDN/LB → API → Cache → Prefix Index → DB

ar.why: الـ path لازم يبقى قصير جدًا.
ar.how: Edge cache للـ hot prefixes. Origin للـ miss.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: DB LIKE '%x%' على كل keystroke.

en.why: The path must be very short.
en.how: Edge cache for hot prefixes. Origin on miss.
en.mistakes: Mistake: DB LIKE '%x%' on every keystroke.

text.ar: Prefix index: Trie أو Redis ZSET lex أو inverted prefix
text.en: Prefix index: Trie or Redis ZSET lex or inverted prefix

ar.how: In-mem trie للـ top corpus. ZSET للـ simpler ops.
ar.tradeoffs: Trie سريع وأصعب في الـ update الموزع.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: جدول SQL من غير index مناسب.

en.how: In-mem trie for top corpus. ZSET for simpler ops.
en.tradeoffs: Trie is fast and harder to update distributed.
en.mistakes: Mistake: SQL table without a proper index.

text.en: Ranking: popularity × text match × context

ar.how: خزّن score مع الإدخالات. Re-rank top K.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: رجّع lexicographic بس.

en.how: Store score with entries. Re-rank top K.
en.mistakes: Mistake: returning lexicographic only.

text.en: Async indexer from source-of-truth DB/stream

ar.why: فصل الكتابة عن الـ suggest path.
ar.how: CDC/Kafka → indexer → reload shards.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: updates sync على كل replicas في request.

en.why: Decouple writes from the suggest path.
en.how: CDC/Kafka → indexer → reload shards.
en.mistakes: Mistake: sync updates to every replica in-request.

prompt.ar: إزاي تـ scale prefix search مع قواميس ضخمة وتحديثات؟
prompt.en: How do you scale prefix search with huge dictionaries and updates?

text.ar: Shard dictionary by first chars أو hash ranges
text.en: Shard dictionary by first chars or hash ranges

ar.how: Router يعرف الـ shard. Hot prefix shards تتكرر.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: shard واحد يحمل كل الـ 'a' الإنجليزية.

en.how: Router knows the shard. Hot prefix shards are replicated.
en.mistakes: Mistake: one shard holding all English 'a'.

text.en: Replica suggest nodes; stateless API

ar.how: N replicas خلف LB. Rolling reload للفهرس.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تخزن الفهرس في API pod من غير plan للـ reload.

en.how: N replicas behind LB. Rolling reload of the index.
en.mistakes: Mistake: storing the index in API pods with no reload plan.

text.ar: Edge cache للـ anonymous popular prefixes
text.en: Edge cache for anonymous popular prefixes

ar.why: نسبة كبيرة من الـ queries متكررة.
ar.how: CDN/key = locale+prefix. Short TTL.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: cache personalized responses على CDN.

en.why: A large share of queries repeats.
en.how: CDN/key = locale+prefix. Short TTL.
en.mistakes: Mistake: caching personalized responses on the CDN.

prompt.ar: SLIs: suggest p99، empty-result rate، index lag.
prompt.en: SLIs: suggest p99, empty-result rate, index lag.

text.ar: p99 suggest < 100ms؛ track client cancel rate
text.en: p99 suggest < 100ms; track client cancel rate

ar.how: Histogram + timeout metrics.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تقيس server بس من غير client abandons.

en.how: Histogram + timeout metrics.
en.mistakes: Mistake: measuring server only without client abandons.

text.en: Index lag and freshness gauges

ar.how: Lag from source commit → searchable.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: مفيش رؤية للـ lag.

en.how: Lag from source commit → searchable.
en.mistakes: Mistake: no visibility into lag.

text.en: Empty-result and toxic-result rates

ar.how: Sample queries. Safety classifier hits.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تهتم بالـ latency بس.

en.how: Sample queries. Safety classifier hits.
en.mistakes: Mistake: caring about latency only.

prompt.ar: Hot prefixes، typo storms، index rebuilds.
prompt.en: Hot prefixes, typo storms, index rebuilds.

text.en: Hot prefixes ('a', 'the', common letters)

ar.how: Precompute top results، replicate hot shards.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: نفس الـ TTL لكل الـ prefixes.

en.how: Precompute top results, replicate hot shards.
en.mistakes: Mistake: same TTL for all prefixes.

text.ar: Typo / bot storms تضرب fuzzy path
text.en: Typo / bot storms hitting fuzzy path

ar.how: Rate limit fuzzy. Captcha scrapers. Fallback prefix-only.
ar.tradeoffs: تقييد fuzzy يقلل UX للأخطاء الإملائية.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: fuzzy مفتوح من غير budget.

en.how: Rate limit fuzzy. Captcha scrapers. Fallback prefix-only.
en.mistakes: Mistake: open fuzzy without a budget.

text.en: Index reload causing memory spikes

ar.how: Blue/green index، reload تدريجي.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: reload in-place يوقف الخدمة.

en.how: Blue/green index, gradual reload.
en.mistakes: Mistake: in-place reload stalls the service.

prompt.ar: In-memory trie vs search engine vs Redis ZSET.
prompt.en: In-memory trie vs search engine vs Redis ZSET.

text.en: In-memory trie vs Elasticsearch

ar.how: Trie/ZSET للـ typeahead الصرف. ES لو query أعقد.
ar.tradeoffs: ES أعقد وأبطأ غالبًا للـ prefix النقي.
ar.examples: Many large apps use custom prefix services.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: ES لكل keystroke من غير cache.

en.how: Trie/ZSET for pure typeahead. ES if queries are richer.
en.tradeoffs: ES is often heavier/slower for pure prefix.
en.examples: Many large apps use custom prefix services.
en.mistakes: Mistake: ES on every keystroke without cache.

text.en: Exact prefix vs fuzzy

ar.how: Prefix أولاً؛ fuzzy عند قلة النتائج.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: fuzzy edit distance كبيرة على QPS عالي.

en.how: Prefix first; fuzzy when results are scarce.
en.mistakes: Mistake: large edit distance fuzzy at high QPS.

text.en: Global popularity vs personalized

ar.how: ابدأ global؛ أضف personalization للـ logged-in.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: personalize كل شيء من اليوم الأول.

en.how: Start global; add personalization for logged-in.
en.mistakes: Mistake: personalizing everything from day one.

prompt.en: Personalization and privacy for query logs.

text.en: Arabic morphology / normalization

ar.how: Normalize قبل الفهرسة والاستعلام.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: casefold إنجليزي بس.

en.how: Normalize before index and query.
en.mistakes: Mistake: English-only casefold.

text.en: Privacy: do not suggest sensitive PII

ar.how: Deny-list types. Authz على private entities.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: typeahead عام على كل اليوزرز الخاصين.

en.how: Deny-list types. Authz on private entities.
en.mistakes: Mistake: public typeahead on all private users.

text.ar: Offline eval + online A/B لـ ranking
text.en: Offline eval + online A/B for ranking

ar.why: من غير قياس، الـ ranking عشوائي.
ar.how: Query sets + CTR experiments.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعتمد على إحساس الـ PM بس.

en.how: Query sets + CTR experiments.
en.tradeoffs: A/B is slow for safety changes.
en.mistakes: Mistake: relying only on PM intuition.

prompt.ar: تكلفة memory للـ tries وreplicas عند 100k QPS.
prompt.en: Memory cost for tries and replicas at 100k QPS.

text.en: Memory: corpus entries × bytes × replicas

ar.how: 100M entries × 100B × 10 replicas…
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تنسى replicas في كل AZ.

en.how: 100M entries × 100B × 10 replicas…
en.tradeoffs: Fewer replicas = cheaper and less availability.
en.mistakes: Mistake: forgetting replicas in every AZ.

text.en: CDN cuts origin QPS sharply

ar.why: Hot prefixes أرخص على الـ edge.
ar.how: Target 70%+ edge hit للـ anonymous.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: كل الطلبات origin.

en.why: Hot prefixes are cheaper at the edge.
en.how: Target 70%+ edge hit for anonymous.
en.mistakes: Mistake: all traffic to origin.

text.en: Indexer compute separated from serve

ar.how: Spot/batch للـ rebuild. Reserved للـ serve.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: reindex على نفس serve nodes تحت الضغط.

en.how: Spot/batch for rebuild. Reserved for serve.
en.mistakes: Mistake: reindexing on the same serve nodes under load.

text.ar: Rate limit per IP/user على suggest
text.en: Rate limit per IP/user on suggest

ar.how: Token bucket + bot detection.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: endpoint عام من غير throttle.

en.how: Token bucket + bot detection.
en.mistakes: Mistake: public endpoint with no throttle.

text.en: Authorization on private entities

ar.how: Filter by ACL بعد الاسترجاع أو index partitions.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تفهرس private ids في public shard.

en.how: Filter by ACL after retrieval or index partitions.
en.mistakes: Mistake: indexing private ids in a public shard.

text.en: Log minimization for queries

ar.how: Hash/truncate. Short retention. Access control.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تخزن raw queries للأبد.

en.why: Query logs contain PII and intent.
en.how: Hash/truncate. Short retention. Access control.
en.mistakes: Mistake: storing raw queries forever.

prompt.en: Multi-region indexes and RPO for updates.

text.ar: Multi-region serve replicas؛ index rebuild من المصدر
text.en: Multi-region serve replicas; index rebuild from source

ar.why: الـ index مش المصدر الوحيد للحقيقة.
ar.how: RPO على المصدر. Indexes تتعيد.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: backups للـ index بس من غير المصدر.

en.why: The index is not the only source of truth.
en.how: RPO on source. Indexes are rebuildable.
en.mistakes: Mistake: index-only backups without source.

text.ar: Failover: اخدم stale index مع علم freshness
text.en: Failover: serve stale index with freshness signal

ar.how: Freeze updates. Serve last good.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: ترفض كل الطلبات لو indexer وقع.

en.how: Freeze updates. Serve last good.
en.mistakes: Mistake: rejecting all requests if indexer fails.

text.ar: Chaos: اقتل shard وشيّك router fallback
text.en: Chaos: kill a shard and check router fallback

ar.how: Partial results vs error policy واضحة.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: 500 على أي shard miss.

en.how: Clear partial results vs error policy.
en.mistakes: Mistake: 500 on any shard miss.

rangeHint.ar: Replicas عبر AZs غالبًا من ٦ لـ ١٦ حسب الـ QPS.
rangeHint.en: Replicas across AZs are often 6–16 depending on QPS.

rangeHint.ar: Suggest node in-memory غالبًا عشرات الآلاف QPS.
rangeHint.en: In-memory suggest nodes often do tens of thousands QPS.

description.ar: الـ shard الخاص بالحرف الشائع واقع. جزء من الاقتراحات فاضي.
description.en: The common-letter shard is down. Some suggestions are empty.

checklist.en: Temporarily disable fuzzy to save capacity

description.ar: IP ranges بتسحب الـ corpus عبر typeahead. الـ QPS ×10.
description.en: IP ranges are scraping the corpus via typeahead. QPS ×10.

question.ar: الفهرس: in-memory trie ولا search engine؟
question.en: Index: in-memory trie or search engine?

expectedNote.ar: للـ typeahead النقي، in-memory عادة أنسب للـ latency.
expectedNote.en: For pure typeahead, in-memory is usually better for latency.

whenOtherWins.ar: Search engine لو محتاج filtering/facets غنية مع الـ suggest.
whenOtherWins.en: Search engine if you need rich filtering/facets with suggest.

expectedNote.ar: Cache للـ anonymous + origin للـ logged-in حل عملي.
expectedNote.en: Cache for anonymous + origin for logged-in is practical.

whenOtherWins.ar: Personalized لو الـ product قائم على التخصيص القوي.
whenOtherWins.en: Personalized if the product depends on strong personalization.

caption.ar: Worker يحدّث/يعيد بناء الـ prefix index
الـ API يقرأ الفهرس الجديد تدريجيًا
caption.en: API gradually reads the new index

caption.ar: CDN ياخد TTL قصير ويفرغ المفاتيح الساخنة
caption.en: CDN uses short TTL and purges hot keys

caption.ar: Hydrate تفاصيل من DB لو لزم
caption.en: Hydrate details from DB if needed
